author: CollinRugg
text:
Funeral home says they are “sorry” for accidentally cremating a woman and presenting someone else with her wig on at an open-casket viewing.

A Detroit family says they showed up at the funeral home only to find someone else in the casket wearing their mother’s clothes.

Yikes.
